indicators.name: Residents owning any health insurance
indicators.concept: Formal financial protection/access entitlement, not facility capacity or health outcome

source.publisher: Badan Pusat Statistik Provinsi Jawa Barat
source.title: Statistik Kesejahteraan Rakyat Provinsi Jawa Barat 2023
source.referencePeriod: Susenas Maret 2023; official household survey estimates
source.table: 4.7 Persentase Penduduk menurut Kabupaten/Kota dan Jenis Jaminan Kesehatan yang Dimiliki, 2023
source.denominator: All resident persons in Susenas Maret 2023; not households and not active administrative JKN accounts

indicators.definition: Complement of explicit Tidak Punya category: residents reporting any health-insurance ownership. Does not sum potentially overlapping insurer categories.
indicators.direction: Higher means lower formal insurance exclusion; not proof of active benefits, affordability or realized treatment.
indicators.comparability: Same household survey, March2023, person denominator, source table and complement rule across all27 canonical districts. Every source row name independently matched PDF coordinates.
indicators.transformation: 100 - published percentage reporting no insurance; retain two-decimal source precision. No administrative population denominator substituted.
limitations: Ownership is self-reported, not verified active contribution/entitlement or successful reimbursement.
Does not measure needed care received, benefit completeness, travel time or quality.
Do not mix with administrative JKN registry percentages, especially registered versus active participants.
Source supplies no-insurance standard errors/RSE/95% intervals in table9.8 continuation, PDF202. Complement retains same standard error in percentage points.
Conceptually complements capacity, but any future healthcare subdimension must avoid dominance from indicator count.

preliminaryRecommendation.reason: Potential next-model financial-access component: all27 official2023 observations, defensible direction for formal coverage, no sum of overlapping insurer shares, and meaningful variation. Final admission depends on integrated redundancy review.

derivation.denominator: All resident persons, official survey weighted population; not administrative JKN registry

indicators.name: Households using electricity or LPG/natural gas/biogas as main cooking fuel
indicators.concept: Cooking energy use; potential cleaner-fuel proxy, not fully measured clean-energy access

source.publisher: Badan Pusat Statistik Provinsi Jawa Barat
source.title: Statistik Kesejahteraan Rakyat Provinsi Jawa Barat 2023
source.referencePeriod: Susenas Maret 2023; official household survey estimates
source.table: 6.17 Persentase Rumah Tangga menurut Kabupaten/Kota dan Bahan Bakar Utama yang Digunakan untuk Memasak, 2023
source.denominator: All households, including households not cooking at home

indicators.definition: Sum of mutually exclusive published electricity and LPG/natural-gas/biogas main-fuel shares. The label is literal, not a claim to measure SDG7.1.2 population access to clean fuels AND technologies.
indicators.direction: Higher indicates more reliance on electricity/gaseous main cooking fuel; generic essential-service pressure direction remains qualified.
indicators.comparability: Same Susenas2023 household main-fuel categories across27. No fuel category or non-cooking household silently recoded.
indicators.transformation: Add published electricity and gas-category percentages; do not sum overlapping categories or annualize.
limitations: Primary fuel use is not verified fuel affordability, continuous supply, appliance technology or emissions.
Population-based clean-cooking SDG measure is not the same household-denominator series.
Other/not-cooking households cannot automatically be classified deprived.
Source table6.17 differs from yearbook4.3.5 in several non-gas cells; one coherent source retained, not mixed.

preliminaryRecommendation.reason: Useful essential-energy context, but does not establish reliable clean-fuel-and-technology access; avoid presenting a constructed fuel-mix percentage as a complete service-quality metric.

indicators.name: Households using LPG/natural gas/biogas as main cooking fuel

source.publisher: Badan Pusat Statistik Provinsi Jawa Barat
source.title: Statistik Kesejahteraan Rakyat Provinsi Jawa Barat 2023
source.referencePeriod: Susenas Maret 2023; official household survey estimates
source.denominator: All households, including households not cooking at home

indicators.definition: Published LPG/natural-gas/biogas main cooking fuel share; electricity is separate and must not be called unserved.
indicators.direction: Not unconditionally monotonic: switching from gas to electric cooking reduces this share without necessarily worsening access.
indicators.comparability: Same published survey category across27; not a gas-grid connection ratio.
limitations: Cannot represent all clean cooking access or LPG affordability.
Directly nested in electric_or_gas_cooking; never independently score both.

preliminaryRecommendation.reason: Fuel-mix context only; replacing electricity with gas has no unqualified welfare direction and duplicates the broader cooking proxy.

findings: New optional service areas were not admitted simply because values exist. Insurance ownership is a separate financial-access concept from facility capacity; cooking-fuel composition remains qualified context.
All source numeric values retained at published precision; official survey estimates only, no custom modeled data.
Survey publication supplies explicit uncertainty for insurance non-coverage: no-insurance RSE ranges3.11–13.50%; the union complement is not a sum of insurer shares.
Full source PDF bytes retained only in analysis memory; no full copyrighted book or temporary script added to repository.
